files.README.md:
# Grangemoor Hide & Tallow - night ledger

The ledger reads hide_batch in one transaction and the stock clerks write to the same table.
The clauses the database team reviewed are carded in sql/lock-clauses.tsv.

turns.prompt: Grangemoor Hide & Tallow lets its night ledger and its stock clerks work on the same hide_batch table. A clerk who writes a row that the ledger has read has to wait until the ledger's transaction has committed. Give the clause to put at the end of the ledger's reading statement so that the clerk's write waits. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
